name: Ryuu no Nemuru Umi
source:
A girl wakes up in the country bestowed by a miracle named 'Dulcis', near a castle and the sea. She does not remember how she got there, nor who she is.
Not long after, a young man, the current King Ziek Dulcis, bumps into her on accident.
He was accompanied by the Imperial Guard Riferl, and they discuss how she got there and what to do.
Before they can properly assess the situation, something strange occurs...
